description_en: Queries all resource access permission application orders initiated by the current user
description_zh: 用于查询当前用户发起的所有资源访问权限申请单
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-my-applications --def-schema MaxCompute --resource-type table --resource '{"DefSchema":"MaxCompute","DefVersion":"v1.0.0","MetaData":{"key":"example-string"}}' --start-time 1771948800000 --end-time 1779724799999 --statuses WAIT_APPROVAL --next-token eyJpZCI6MTIzfQ== --page-size 20 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMyApplications

parameters.help_en:
Filters by resource type.

Note: The resource types supported by the system for applications are constrained by [ResourceSchema](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).name.

See also: [ResourceSchema documentation for International site](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)
parameters.help_zh:
根据资源类型筛选。

注意：系统支持申请的资源类型受 [ResourceSchema](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).name 约束。

附：[ResourceSchema国际站说明文档](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)

parameters.help_en:
Filters by minimum permission resource type.

Note: The minimum permission resource type is constrained by [ResourceSchema](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions).resources[*].isValidLeaf being true.

See also: [ResourceSchema documentation for International site](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)
parameters.help_zh:
根据最小权限资源类型筛选。

注意：最小权限资源类型受 [ResourceSchema](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions). resources[*].isValidLeaf 为true 约束。

附：[ResourceSchema国际站说明文档](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dataworks/developer-reference/resourceschema-template-instructions)
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Filters by approval status. Valid values:

- WaitApproval: pending approval.
- Confirmed: pending authorization.
- RejectApproval: approval rejected.
- AuthorizeSucceed: authorization succeeded.
- AuthorizeFailed: authorization failed.
- Deleted: deleted.
- Canceled: withdrawn
parameters.help_zh:
审批状态筛选。枚举：

- WaitApproval 待审批
- Confirmed 待授权
- RejectApproval 审批拒绝
- AuthorizeSucceed 授权成功
- AuthorizeFailed 授权失败
- Deleted 已删除
- Canceled 已撤回
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 200
